name: whetstone
description: Agent skills that sharpen research workflows — neuroimaging pipelines and scientific writing

skills.name: bidsapp-nidm-standards
skills.description: Standards for creating NIDM-integrated BIDSapps that run through BABS. Trigger keywords: BIDSapp, NIDM, BABS, FreeSurfer, repository structure
skills.author: Yibei Chen

skills.name: neuroimaging-qc
skills.description: Evidence-based QC decision-making for neuroimaging data (fMRI, EEG, fNIRS, structural MRI). Interpret QC metrics from fMRIPrep, MRIQC, FreeSurfer, MNE-Python, Homer3 to make justified inclusion/exclusion decisions. Trigger keywords: QC, quality control, fMRIPrep, MRIQC, motion, exclusion, subject filtering
skills.author: Yibei Chen

skills.name: fmri-ssm
skills.description: State-space models (SSMs) for fMRI analysis: HMM, HMM-MAR, sticky/HDP-HMM, IO-HMM, SLDS, rSLDS, SNLDS. Covers resting-state, task-based (MID, SST, N-back), and naturalistic fMRI. Trigger keywords: HMM on brain data, brain state dynamics, dynamic FC, switching dynamics, latent states from BOLD, SLDS on neural timeseries, fMRI state-space modeling
skills.author: Yibei Chen

skills.name: dicom2fmriprep
skills.description: Generate scripts for the full fMRI preprocessing pipeline: DICOM to BIDS conversion (heudiconv), BIDS validation, fMRIPrep with Singularity, and large-scale HPC processing via BABS on SLURM. Trigger keywords: DICOM, BIDS, heudiconv, fMRIPrep, BABS, SLURM, preprocessing, dcm2niix, heuristic
skills.author: Yibei Chen

skills.name: bids-format
skills.description: BIDS standard for all data types — naming conventions, dataset creation, multi-modal conversion (heudiconv, dcm2bids, MNE-BIDS, pypet2bids), validation, derivatives structure, project organization, DataLad, sharing. Trigger keywords: BIDS format, BIDS dataset, BIDS naming, BIDS entities, BIDS convert, multi-modal BIDS, behavioral BIDS, EEG BIDS, DWI BIDS, PET BIDS, derivatives, phenotype, DataLad, OpenNeuro
skills.author: Yibei Chen

skills.name: neuro-plotting
skills.description: Publication-quality matplotlib plotting for scientific papers with deep cognitive neuroscience support. Covers colorblind-friendly palettes, compact figure sizing, font scaling, colorbar placement, brain surface rendering (surfplot, yabplot, nilearn), Yeo-7 network colors, transition matrices, state occupancy, dwell times, connectivity heatmaps, multi-panel composition. Trigger keywords: matplotlib, figure, plot, colormap, colorbar, brain surface, Yeo network, heatmap, transition matrix, dwell time, DPI, font size, journal figure
skills.author: Yibei Chen

skills.name: scientific-writer
skills.description: Write rigorous scientific manuscripts following academic standards (IMRAD, citations, figures, CONSORT/STROBE/PRISMA guidelines). Trigger keywords: scientific writing, research papers, grant proposals, literature reviews
skills.author: Yibei Chen
